subject: Learning Methods
title: Calibration Through Teaching
description: A quick, practical guide to Calibration Through Teaching.

hook.text: Before teaching, students rated their understanding at 8 out of 10. After teaching, they revised down to 5.

buildup.text: Calibration is the alignment between confidence and actual ability. Poor calibration means overconfidence.

discovery.text: Teaching is the most powerful calibration tool. It provides immediate feedback on what you know versus think you know.

twist.text: Well-calibrated learners study more efficiently. They know which topics need work and which are truly mastered.

climax.text: Regularly teach or explain what you learn. The gap between confidence and performance will narrow with each attempt.

punchline.text: Teach to calibrate. Know what you actually know.

quiz.question: How does teaching improve calibration?
options: It gives immediate feedback on actual versus perceived understanding
Students always praise teachers, boosting their self-image
